/* Attd01Mapper.selectSchHistList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.HIST_IDX AS histIdx , A.SCH_CD AS schCd , DATE_FORMAT(A.APPLY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyDate
, CONCAT( A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , '-' , A.FST_SCH_END_TIME ) AS fstSchTime , A.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN AS fstSchBrkMin
, CONCAT( A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , '-' , A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME ) AS secSchTime , A.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN AS secSchBrkMin
, A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.INSERT_NO AS userId , B.USER_NM AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS insertDate FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST A INNER JOIN TB_USER B ON ( A.INSERT_NO = B.USER_ID ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{token.gv_cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{param.siteCd} AND A.SCH_CD = #{param.schCd} ORDER BY A.CMPNY_CD, A.SITE_CD, A.HIST_IDX
